messages:
Eli: Heads up — customer C wants console to surface 'sensitive' routing/quota changes in real-time (who, what, why). They want a visible badge and link to the audit export when a routing policy or quota is edited.
Priya: +1 on the badge. Question: do we compute sensitivity server-side (ruleset) or infer on the client from diff size? Server-side seems more reliable for exports/telemetry.
Jordan: leaning server-side. We already tag change events with `change_type` and `actor_id`. Proposing a new `change_severity` enum: low/medium/high. High when routing affects >X tenants or quota delta >Y. That would also help export filters.
Marta: If we add `change_severity` it needs to be in the audit event shape ASAP — exports, webhook consumers, SIEM integrations expect stable schema. Breaking change risk. Could we add as optional field and document it?
Eli: Optional field is fine. But we need to decide naming and values now because the console UX will read it to show red/yellow/none badge. Also affects alert rules in telemetry.
Priya: Telemetry ask: emit `audit.change.badge_shown` and `audit.change.clicked` with `change_severity` and `route_ids` so we know adoption. Also sample the payload for PII concerns.
Jordan: Implementation detail: runtime rule evaluation will need to compute affected_tenant_count and quota_delta. That means adding a lightweight diffing step in the change path. Perf impact? Probably small but needs perf test.
Marta: For perf, we can make the badge computation async: write event without severity, compute severity in background and update an "enriched" audit index. Console can show provisional badge (grey) and flip to colored once enriched. Safer for write latency.
Eli: How will this impact exports (NDJSON daily export)? Consumers want stable lines that say who did what at time t. If severity is async, export must include both original and enriched versions or mark enrichment timestamp.
Priya: I propose audit export rows include `enrichment_ts` and `enrichment_state` (pending/complete). Consumer can filter where `enrichment_state=complete` if they need final signal. For streaming webhooks we can emit an enrichment update event too.
Jordan: API debate: add a new endpoint `/audit/events/enriched` or extend `/audit/events` with query param `?include_enriched=true`. Prefer param to avoid duplicate endpoints.
Marta: Agree on param. Also add pagination hint for large exports. And we must add a field `affected_routes: [id]` as strings (can be empty).
Eli: UI: add small in-line banner "Sensitive routing change — view evidence" with link to presigned export for that event. Access control: only users with `audit:view` can follow link.
Priya: Security note: presigned export links should have short TTL and be scoped to the user session. Also redact actor email if export requested by non-admin. That ties back to PII handling in export flows.
Jordan: Quick sample of proposed event JSON (inline):
```
{
  "event_id": "evt_abc",
  "actor_id": "u_123",
  "change_type": "routing_update",
  "change_severity": "high",
  "affected_routes": ["r1","r2"],
  "enrichment_state": "complete",
  "enrichment_ts": "1719001230"
}
```
Marta: Looks fine. Make sure export consumers can opt out of `affected_routes` (PII/size) via `redaction=partial` parameter on export API.
Eli: Next: rollout plan. Start with console-only badge reading `change_severity` when present. Background enrichment v1 writes `enrichment_state`. Exports include fields but default to `redaction=standard`. We'll feature-flag the presigned links behind `audit_presigned_links`.
Priya: I'll add telemetry events and the new schema docs. Jordan/Marta can prototype server-side diff + enrichment worker.
Jordan: I can do a lightweight perf run — estimate 95th latency increase: +5ms on commit path with async arg. If that holds, we ship.
release-bot: Draft release note: "Console: sensitive change badging (opt-in). Audit API: optional `change_severity`, `affected_routes`, and enrichment metadata. Export: new `redaction` param and `enrichment_state`." :memo:
Eli: Great. Can someone open a short RFC with the schema and rollout checklist? I'll link to compliance for review.
